predictions.rationale: Central coordinator of the "simple agents"; controls background critique thread, schedules critics, and distributes findings to the rest of the cognitive subsystem.
Abstract definition of the individual agent (critic) that analyses the design and produces suggestions; key to implementing the feature’s logic.
Represents the active designer context and stores the current goals and decisions; many critics query it while producing advice.
Boot-straps and starts the background critique process when the application launches, ensuring agents run continuously.
Implements the control mechanism that decides which critics to invoke and when, directly supporting continuous background analysis.
Concrete implementation of the control mechanism that schedules standard critics, refining how suggestions are generated.
Allows composition of several critics into a single agent, enhancing the sophistication of suggestions delivered to the designer.
Collects and manages the set of generated suggestions (to-do items) resulting from the background agents’ analyses.
Represents an individual suggestion or improvement identified by a critic; fundamental data structure exposed to the user.
Concrete example of a critic detecting a specific design issue (operation name conflict), illustrating direct implementation of automatic advice.
